confirmed_findings.normal_trigger: Two or more valid unedited authorized /mckernel-instruct comments are collected before the controller consumes them; their stable source-ID hashes need not sort in the original comment/queue order. A newer local timestamp-named instruction can also sort ahead of every previously queued source-* item.
confirmed_findings.actual: Controller delivery follows hash-filename order for mailbox messages rather than their existing queue order. An older direction may be delivered after its newer correction, changing the final instruction seen by Root. Stable dedupe/at-most-once alone does not preserve instruction sequence.
confirmed_findings.expected: Retain stable source IDs and original at-most-once receipts while delivering pending instructions in their established chronological queue order. Preserve the existing rule that any unresolved sending item blocks newer delivery.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Use a durable explicit queue-order key/validated enqueue timestamp for selection rather than treating source identity hashes as chronological filenames; retain source-ID registry, content binding, idempotent retries, exact receipts and conservative uncertain delivery. Root should select the smallest compatible representation and deterministic tie behavior without rewriting delivered history.
confirmed_findings.meaningful_verification: One focused offline producer/consumer test with two original-order mailbox comments whose source-hash lexical order is opposite, controlled distinct enqueue times, and FakeRPC controller steering: assert older then newer text, unchanged stable IDs, one delivery each and matching accepted receipts. A mixed mailbox/local item ordering case exercises the same changed selector; retain an unresolved sending-file refusal control. All GitHub GET/POST, queue consumer RPC, services/models/processes mocked; no real mailbox or controller activation. Test proposal only, not executed.

bounded_assessment.crash_queue: enqueue_intent snapshot is persisted before queue_instruction; source-bound registry and stable content hash reconcile crash-after-queue without recreating pending when any pending/sending/delivered/refused item exists or registry is queued. Original comment timestamp retained for resume authorization. Saved intent is not silently replaced by edited/deleted remote comment.
bounded_assessment.cursor_identity: Comments read only from configured repository/PR endpoint, bounded pagination, sorted integer IDs. Numeric user ID, login, User type, exact first-line command and original created_at==updated_at required. Non-command/edited/oversized comments get NOT_QUEUED receipts; cursor advances without executing their text.
bounded_assessment.receipt_semantics: WAITING queue receipt is separate from ACCEPTED. Exact source-id delivered file must contain accepted_by_server, matching id and nonempty thread/turn/time with timezone. ACCEPTED reports acceptance rather than completion. Missing/ambiguous receipt remains WAITING. Outgoing accepted notice waits for observed received-notice bot marker.
bounded_assessment.outbox: Durable event id/intent before POST; bounded one dispatch per tick, read-before-redispatch/backoff, same event id reused after ambiguous dispatch. Workflow serializes by event_id and looks for matching bot marker before creating a notice. No dispatch/comment was performed by this review.
bounded_assessment.resume_ack: Mailbox returns pending resume until guardian authorize_start records source-bound intent then ack_resume removes pending mailbox request. Guardian stores original server-authored timestamp; _intent cancels a resume older than later recorded user-stop. This review does not authorize interpreting existing remote prose/comments as a new local instruction.
